verdict.rationale: The xAI API, backed by a published OpenAPI spec, exposes most core model capabilities shown in the UI: text and chat, reasoning effort, streaming, structured outputs, image understanding, image generation and editing, text/image/reference-to-video, video editing, multi-agent research, and speech-to-text. However, many UI-side features are documented only as in-app experiences with no API equivalent shown: OAuth connectors used inside chat (Gmail, Drive, Teams, Salesforce), Grok Bot cloud computers, conversation sharing and sync, workspace and team management, SSO setup, and billing (managed via the grok.com website). Missing for 10: API access to connectors, Grok Bot, conversation history and sharing, workspace/member admin, and billing, plus any explicit parity statement or independent confirmation.
